searchPlaceholder: Search titles, aliases, tags, categories, or content summaries
searchHint: Type ? plus a description to search by meaning (enable AI in this plugin's settings)
setupHint: Items are saved in SiYuan documents and remain editable. You will confirm before creating a document.
setupUsageGuide: Quick start: create an item in the panel or capture clipboard text; select a search result, then use the actions to insert or copy it. {{xlc:ask:field}} prompts when an item is used.
setupRecommendation: Recommended: create a dedicated library document in an existing notebook (this never creates a notebook). Categories stay with each item; templates are imported there only after you confirm.
setupQuickStart1Desc: Click “New item”, or save a selection, clipboard text, or a context-menu target.
setupQuickStart2Desc: Search by title, tag, or category; select an item to preview it.
setupQuickStart3Desc: Press Enter to insert or copy it and paste; templates can ask for values when used.
setupCreateNotebook: Choose an existing notebook (no notebook is created)
setupNotebookNeedsDocsCheck: After you choose a notebook, the next step checks its root documents.
setupNotebookDocsReady: Root documents checked. Continue to set up the library.
setupNotebookEmpty: No notebooks are available. Create one in SiYuan first, or choose an existing document instead.
setupNotebookLoadFailed: Could not load notebooks. Retry or choose an existing doc.
setupNotebookNotReady: The notebook list is still loading. Wait or choose an existing doc.
setupNotebookNoDocs: This notebook has no root documents. Create a library doc first or choose an existing doc.
setupNotebookDocsCheckFailed: Could not check root documents. Retry.
setupConfirmCreate: Create "%s" and set it as the current library?
clipboardReadFailed: Cannot read clipboard (permission or platform limit); please enter it manually
title: Title
copiedRichPending: Copied markdown link; bitmap copy pending device verification
insertNoEditor: No active editor; copied to clipboard instead
insertFailed: Insert failed. Check that the current document is editable and try again.
insertPendingMobile: Direct insert on mobile pending verification; copied to clipboard
sourceGone: The original content block was moved or deleted. Edit this item to assign a new source.
deleteConfirm: Delete item "%s"? Only the library block is removed; source docs untouched.
reindexTruncated: Item count exceeds limit %s; truncated (rest stay safe in library docs)
libInvalid: Library config invalid, please set up again
startupFailed: LvCommon (Beta) failed to start: %s. Commands are still registered; reload the plugin and retry
sidecarLoadFailed: LvCommon (Beta) could not read its local settings and is using defaults; entries remain available

importDone: Import done: created %s / skipped %s / overwritten %s / renamed %s / failed %s
importFailed: Import failed: invalid file (%s); original data untouched
previewNoResult: Select an item on the left to preview it here
usageHint: ↑ ↓ select · Enter insert · Ctrl/⌘ + Enter copy · Alt + 1-9 quick insert · Esc close
usageHintMobile: Tap an item to try inserting; if unsupported, it is copied · long-press for actions
usageGuideIntro: Save frequently used content in SiYuan documents, then search, preview, insert, or copy it.
usageGuideAdd: Add: click “＋ New item”, or save a selection, current block, clipboard text, or context-menu target.
usageGuideSearch: Find: search titles, aliases, summaries, tags, and categories; try pinyin, Favorites, Recent, or Frequent sort.
usageGuideInsert: Use: Enter inserts the selected item, Ctrl/⌘ + Enter copies it, and Alt/⌥ + 1-9 inserts the matching item; long-press a row for more actions.
usageGuideInsertMobile: Use: tap an item to try inserting it; if unsupported, it is copied. Mobile insertion is not verified in the real client; long-press for more actions.
usageGuideOrganize: Organize: use clear titles, tags, and categories; Settings → Data & Templates includes email, address, and contact examples.
usageGuideVariables: Template rules: {{xlc:ask:field}} asks at insert time; {{xlc:date}} and {{xlc:clipboard}} expand only when used, without changing the saved original. AI is off by default.
aiShareContent: Let AI read full item content
aiDraftDesc: Describe the content you want; AI drafts it
aiDraftNeedDescription: Describe what you want to generate first
aiSemanticHint: Type ? plus a description, e.g. “?apology reply to client”. AI recommends items using titles, aliases, tags, categories, and summaries; it does not read full content.
aiDisabled: AI assistant is off (enable in plugin settings)
aiNotConfigured: No AI model configured in SiYuan (Settings → AI)
aiEmpty: AI returned nothing (not configured or call failed)
aiTimeout: AI call timed out, please retry
aiContentNotAllowed: Enable "Let AI read full item content" first
captureBlockNone: Cursor is not inside a block; cannot locate current block
sortHint.manual: While browsing, favorites come first, then recent use and update time; search keeps favorites first, then ranks by relevance
sortHint.recent: While browsing, recently used items come first; search remains ranked by relevance
sort.title: Sort by title
sortHint.title: Sort the browse list by title; search remains ranked by relevance

tagAuditTitle: AI tag audit (suggestions only, no auto changes)

emptyFiltered: No items match the current filters
setAsLibraryConfirm: Set the %s selected docs as your common library (replaces current config)?

usageStatsHint: Usage stats stay on this device
clearUsageConfirm: Clear all usage counts? Frequent sort falls back to recently used.
importPolicySkipDesc: Keep existing items; only add missing ones
importPolicyOverwriteDesc: Overwrite existing items with imported content
importPolicyRenameDesc: Imported items get a suffix; existing stay untouched
importReceiptHint: A per-item receipt follows: created / skipped / overwritten / renamed / failed
setupConfirmHint: Creating asks for explicit confirmation and never touches existing docs; change later in Settings → Current library.
setupSummaryDoc: Items are saved in this document and remain editable
setupSummaryNotebook: Index top-level docs in the notebook and save new items in the first doc
setupSummaryTree: Index the selected doc and up to 3 child levels; new items are saved in the selected root doc
aiEnabledSub: Uses the model from SiYuan Settings → AI; no keys stored
aiShareContentSub: Needed by tidy/transform/draft; metadata-only when off
placeholdersToggleSub: Replaces {{xlc:date}} etc. at insert/copy time; {{xlc:date|+3d}} date math, {{xlc:random|A,B}} random pick
packContentsHint:
- Item Markdown + metadata (title/tags/category)
- Variable list ({{xlc:ask:…}} fields and options)
- Asset references (assets bundled as-is)
packTrustHint: Recipients get real SiYuan blocks they can edit and re-share — you share live blocks, not text snapshots.
emptyFavoritesSub: Tap the ☆ on a row to favorite it and find it quickly under Favorites

promptPackHint: 16 built-in quick guide, address, email, contact, support, AI prompt, and dev writing templates. Choose duplicate handling before import; items are stored in the current library doc with category metadata.

emptyQueryHint: The new item form will use this search term as its title. You can edit it.

captureHint: Saved to the current library · fill in variables when inserting
